meta.title: Features — ExperimentLens
meta.description: Every capability ExperimentLens ships — for agents & LLMs ( traces, judges, verdicts, session comparison) and for ML experiments (parallel-coordinates analysis, comparative views, explainability, workflow drill-down).
meta.ogDescription: The full feature surface of ExperimentLens — observability & explainability for agents, LLMs and ML experiments.

hero.title: The full surface of ExperimentLens.
hero.subtitle: ExperimentLens is the visualization layer on top of your agent stack, tracking server and execution engine. It makes every trace, verdict, metric, parameter and artifact you capture explorable, comparable and explainable.

showcase.title: What you can do in ExperimentLens.
showcase.subtitle: Every run links to its traces — explorable down to a single LLM call.

features.title: Agentic runs sit beside your ML runs.
features.body: Every agentic configuration is a run in the same overview — parameters, metrics and a parallel-coordinates view — so you compare RAG settings like chunk size, search type and prompt exactly the way you compare model hyperparameters.
bullets: Shared run table for agentic and ML experiments
Parallel coordinates over agentic parameters
One run links to one or many traces

features.title: Follow every span from retrieval to answer.
features.body: Records each observation — retriever, LLM call and judges — as a connected trace. Inspect inputs, outputs, latency, tokens and cost per step, or open the graph view to see the whole run at once.
bullets: Spans, generations, retrievers & events per trace
Per-observation latency, tokens and cost
List and graph views of the full trace

features.title: Judges and checks on every answer.
features.body: Each trace is scored by LLM-as-judge dimensions and deterministic checks, rolled up into a single pass-rate. Read the rationale behind every verdict — including why a check failed.
bullets: Correctness, groundedness, relevance, completeness & conciseness judges
Deterministic checks: citation validity, exact match, keyword presence, latency
Per-check rationale and an overall pass-rate

features.title: Compare configurations side by side.
features.body: Select any subset of runs and switch between summary, timeline and verdict views. Mosaic charts, a cumulative latency race and a verdict diff highlight exactly what changed — every regression and fix.
bullets: Mosaic & stacked summaries for latency, tokens and pass %
Cumulative latency race across the run timeline
Verdict diff that flags each regression and fix

features.title: Dashboards for cost, latency and quality.
features.body: Aggregate sessions, traces, tokens, cost and judge pass-rates in one place. Drill into per-trace pass/fail across judges, or into score distributions for every metric and check.
bullets: Session, trace, token, cost and error roll-ups
Per-trace judge pass/fail with latency & tokens
Verdict pass-rates and full score distributions

features.title: See which agent step is the bottleneck.
features.body: Per-agent latency and call-frequency breakdowns separate the retriever, generator and judges, so you can tell where time and tokens actually go before you optimize.
bullets: Per-agent average latency by span type
Call frequency per agent across the session
Isolate retriever vs. generator vs. judge cost

deep.title: The full agentic feature surface.
deep.subtitle: Everything ExperimentLens ships for agents and LLM apps, at a glance.

items.title: Trace ingestion
items.body: Every run links to one or many traces — spans, generations, retrievers and events.

items.title: LLM-as-judge verdicts
items.body: Define your own judges when you set up the experiment — get pass/fail verdicts with written rationale.

items.title: Deterministic checks
items.body: Configure citation validity, exact match, keyword presence, latency checks, retrieval hit/recall and more for your experiment — scored automatically once defined.

items.title: Verdict diff
items.body: A per-question grid across runs that flags regressions and fixes between judge and check outcomes.

items.title: Per-agent performance
items.body: Latency and call-frequency breakdowns per agent step, plus session-level P95, tokens and cost.

items.title: Token & cost tracking
items.body: Prompt and completion tokens with cost aggregated per observation, per trace, per session and per experiment.

items.title: Question & answer view
items.body: Read the full model answer with citations alongside the judge verdicts for that trace.

items.title: Conversation replay
items.body: Edit a prompt on any observation and re-run the exact same call to compare outputs in place.

showcase.title: What you can do in ExperimentLens.

features.title: Find the configuration that actually moves the metric.
features.body: Plot hundreds of runs on a single linked parallel-coordinates view. Brush an axis, watch the table filter. Group by any hyperparameter, color by any metric — and see which choices matter before you launch another sweep.
bullets: Multi-axis parallel coordinates with live brushing
Group, color and filter by any logged parameter
Bidirectional sync between chart and run table

features.title: Compare runs side-by-side across metrics, models and data.
features.body: Select any subset of runs and switch between Metrics, Models and Data tabs. Mosaic and stacked layouts let you spot regressions and tradeoffs in the metrics you logged.
bullets: Mosaic & stacked metric layouts
Cross-run model & dataset diffs
Status-aware comparison (completed / scheduled)

features.title: From monitoring to steering.
features.body: Monitor and steer pipeline executions at runtime, guided by intermediate results and visual feedback. Use diagnostic views to adjust configuration choices and re-launch modified pipelines.
bullets: Monitor and steer pipeline executions at runtime
Guided by intermediate results and visual feedback
Adjust configuration choices and re-launch modified pipelines

features.title: PDP, ALE and feature importance — wired to your runs.
features.body: Open the Explainability tab to see global post-hoc explanations attached to the same experiment context. No notebooks, no glue code.
bullets: Feature importance per variability point
Partial Dependence Plots (PDP)
Accumulated Local Effects (ALE) & counterfactuals

features.title: Drill into a single workflow's parameters, metrics & artifacts.
features.body: Inspect the exact parameters, metrics and artifacts that the run logged to the tracking server. Ratings and status help curate the runs that matter.
bullets: Parameters, metrics & artifacts pane
Run rating & status surfacing
Direct link from any comparative view

items.title: Comparative analysis
items.body: Mosaic & stacked layouts to diff metrics, models and datasets across selected runs.

items.title: Run Inspection

items.title: Pipeline monitoring
items.body: Track pipeline progress (completed / running / failed) and steer human-in-the-loop refinements.

items.title: Artifact & data inspection
items.body: Preview inputs, outputs, predictions and intermediate artifacts in context with the run.

items.title: Integrated Explainability
items.body: Apply post-hoc explainability methods like counterfactual examples, PDP, and ALE directly inside the experiment context.

items.title: Extensible adapter API
items.body: Add a new tracker or engine without touching the frontend — the adapter contract is the only seam.

items.title: Run Steering
items.body: Use diagnostic views to adjust configuration choices and re-launch modified pipelines as part of the same experiment.
